subtopic: Schedule II and III quantity limits
stem: A pharmacist evaluates a phendimetrazine prescription. Select all rules that may apply.

choices.text: The non-opioid Schedule III single-fill quantity pathway must be considered.
Schedule III status permits unlimited refills.
Federal Schedule III refill limits still apply to any authorized refills.
The drug is a Schedule VI legend drug in Massachusetts.
A Schedule II remainder may be filled for 30 days without using refill rules.

explanation.core_reasoning: Apply each proposition independently. Massachusetts generally limits Schedule II and III opioid prescriptions to a 30-day supply and recognizes defined 90-day pathways for OUD drugs, non-opioid Schedule II or III drugs, and implantable infusion pumps. A Schedule III or IV prescription may not be filled or refilled more than six months after issue and may not be refilled more than five times unless renewed by the practitioner. phendimetrazine (Bontril) is used for short-term adjunct in a weight-reduction regimen. It is federal Schedule III and Massachusetts Schedule III; its legal consequence in this scenario follows the cited schedule-specific rule.
